Summary

Table Name

BEN_PRTN_ELIG_PRFL_F

Purpose

Defines and manages eligibility rules for employees participating in benefit plans. Acts as a junction between eligibility criteria and participation rules, ensuring that only qualified employees can enroll in specific benefit offerings.

Key columns:

  • PRTN_ELIG_PRFL_ID
  • EFFECTIVE_START_DATE & EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  • BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
  • NAME & DESCRIPTION
  • ELIGY_PRFL_TYPE_CD
  • ELIGIBILITY_RULE_ID

Technical considerations

Subject to standard Oracle HRMS data security and multi-org access control. Heavily indexed for optimal query performance during eligibility validation processes. Supports Oracle Application Object Library (AOL) features, such as auditing and flexfields.

Tags

  • Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS)

    • Oracle HRMS (Human Resource Management System)
    • Benefits Administration
    • Eligibility Profiles
    • Benefit Plans
    • Employee Eligibility
    • Data Security

Business unit

Information Systems (IS) / Enterprise Applications (EA)

Categories

  • Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS)

    • Human Capital Management (HCM)
    • Benefits
    • Data Management
    • Security and Access Control

AI_Description

The BEN_PRTN_ELIG_PRFL_F table is a crucial component in Oracle EBS's Benefits Administration module. It manages employment eligibility for benefit programs, ensuring only suitable employees can enroll. The table is date-effective, maintained under rigorous data security, and extensible through Oracle AOL features. Its integration with other EBS HRMS tables streamlines the organization's employee benefits management.

Additional Context

Key relations with HCM modules: BEN_PL_F (benefit plan), BEN_ELIGY_PRFL_F (additional attributes), BEN_ELIG_RSTRN_F (eligibility restrictions).

Additional resources for table structure and API documentation: Oracle Cloud HCM Classic, Oracle Service Providers Managed Cloud HCM.

Conclusion

This summary provides an overview of the BEN_PRTN_ELIG_PRFL_F table in the context of Oracle EBS 12.1.1 and 12.2.2. By understanding its structure and functionality, you can effectively manage employee eligibility for various benefit plans within your organization.

For additional details about the BEN_PRTN_ELIG_PRFL_F table and its role in Oracle EBS, please refer to the additional context mentioned above.
